candidates.fdm: Toothed plates laced on pins. Prints. Sprocket is a new profile (inverted tooth), not a roller envelope. Hy-Vo rocker pin is an optional joint, not a second kit.
candidates.name: silent_chain
candidates.why: Inverted-tooth / silent chain. High speed, quiet, camshafts, transfers. Distinct from roller_chain (round rollers) and from a gear (the chain flexes around). The missing power-chain family.

candidates.api_shape: leaf_chain_link(pitch, lacing, plate_t) running on a sheave, not a sprocket
candidates.fdm: Interleaved plates, no rollers. Prints. Forklift masts, counterweights. The sheave is the pulleys primitive.
candidates.name: leaf_chain
candidates.why: BL / AL leaf chain. No sprocket, only a sheave. The other named lifting chain. Not a roller and not a drag_chain.

candidates.api_shape: pintle_link(pitch, hook) open hook-and-bar, coarse, dirty
candidates.fdm: An open hook into the next bar. Extremely FDM-friendly. Agricultural, sewage, lumber. Attachments weld or print on the bar.
candidates.name: pintle_chain
candidates.why: Block / pintle / 400-class. The open-joint cousin of roller chain. Prints as one piece per link. The farm-machine request.

candidates.api_shape: roller_chain_link(..., pin='hollow') so attachments drop through
candidates.fdm: A tube instead of a solid pin. Argument, not a second module.
candidates.name: hollow_pin
candidates.why: Conveyor attachments. Named, but it is a pin option on the existing link.

candidates.api_shape: ball_chain(ball_d, wire, n) + a pocket sprocket or a keyway pull
candidates.fdm: Spheres and wire, or printed beads on a string. Pulls, does not transmit real power. Key fobs, blinds, cheap indexing.
candidates.name: ball_chain
candidates.why: The cheap pull chain. Not a drive. A bead + pocket wheel is a thin kit so agents stop inventing it from cyl.

candidates.api_shape: a pintle or roller with a flat slat on top
candidates.fdm: Prints. Bottle conveyors. Getting product-shaped (the slat table).
candidates.name: flat_top_chain
candidates.why: Table-top / slat chain. An attachment on pintle or hollow-pin, not a new joint.

candidates.api_shape: two-piece rocker pin inside a silent chain
candidates.fdm: Tiny, steel in service. A joint option on silent_chain.
candidates.name: hyvo_rocker
candidates.why: Morse Hy-Vo. After silent_chain exists. Do not claim Borg-Warner conjugacy.

candidates.fdm: Habasit / Intralox modules. A product family.
candidates.name: modular_plastic_belt
candidates.why: Injection-moulded conveyor belt. Finished product. Not a mechlib chain.

candidates.name: roller_again
candidates.why: Already the default drive chain. Do not add a second roller.

candidates.name: drag_again
candidates.why: Cable carrier, not a drive chain.

rejected.name: engineering_class_scale
rejected.why: Offset-sidebar / 81X is a large dirty roller. Scale + clearance on roller_chain_link, not a new joint.

rejected.name: oring_chain
rejected.why: Sealed motorcycle chain. Bought O-rings on a roller. Hardware.

summary:
A chain is a wrapping pair made of discrete links. Fractory / Tsubaki split power-transmission chains by joint: roller (bush + roller on a pin), silent / inverted-tooth (toothed plates, no roller), leaf (stacked plates, no sprocket, a sheave), and engineering/offset-sidebar (large, dirty). Conveyor cousins are pintle/block, hollow-pin, flat-top, and modular plastic belt. Ball chain is a cheap pull. 507 names chain pulleys 227-229 and a sprocket 254.

Catalog already covers the roller family and the cable-carrier. roller_chain_link / roller_chain, roller_sprocket_2d, plus layout posers chain_reverse, chain_s_wrap, chain_dual_output. drag_chain / drag_chain_link is an energy chain, not a drive. Grep finds no silent chain, inverted tooth, leaf chain, pintle, block chain, hollow-pin, or ball chain.

FDM reality. Silent / inverted-tooth is a stack of toothed plates that engage a sprocket with straight or involute flanks (Morse Hy-Vo is the rocker-pin high-speed cousin). Prints as plates + pins; the sprocket is a new tooth, not roller_sprocket_2d. Leaf chain is a forklift/mast chain: interleaved plates, no rollers, runs on a sheave not a sprocket; the sheave (pulleys slice) plus a plate stack is the kit. Pintle / block is an open hook-and-bar agricultural/sewage chain, very FDM-friendly, coarse pitch. Hollow-pin is a roller chain whose pins are tubes for attachments; an argument on roller_chain_link. Ball chain is spheres and wire, a pull not a drive. Modular plastic belt (Habasit/Intralox) is a product. Engineering class is a scaled dirty roller. Do not add a second roller_chain.
title: Chain types beyond roller and drag
